text:
alex: Heads-up — Linh from vendor just flagged that EU customs reclassified the HS code for H100-series. PO#8329 (48 units) may be held. Need an operational plan: backfill options, RMA flow, and cost.

linh_vendor: Sorry about the hit. Customs issued a retro HS change this morning. We expect a clearance delay ~6–10 days unless we reroute to NL crossdock and refile — expedite charge +$2,300 per pallet. Alternative: temporary loaner lease (limited stock) while originals clear.

maria: This is rough — that PO was the primary backfill for west-eu cluster. Current spare pool = 8 GPUs, projected saturation of low-priority queues in ~36h. We need at least 24 units in-prod to avoid throttling.

tj_ops: Can we steal from perf bench? There are ~30 units in bench. Reassigning 24 would impact benchmarks but keep prod healthy.

alex: Approve reassign 24 from bench -> prod immediately. Linh, can you 1) provide loaners for immediate lease, 2) confirm crossdock timeline and 3) absorb any customs admin if we accept reroute?

linh_vendor: We can offer 12 loaners (short on stock today) for emergency lease at $45/unit/day, 7-day min. Crossdock ETA: arrival to NL within 48h after paperwork, customs clearance 24–72h. We can absorb 50% of customs admin fee ($680 admin) if you accept split routing and sign updated paperwork. RMA process: for DOA we do depot swap with 48h SLA once items are in custody.

maria: Lease math check: 12 * 7 * $45 = $3,780 + crossdock $2,300 = $6,080. Also we may need air-bridge for 8 extra units — cost estimate?

linh_vendor: Air-bridge for 8 units ~ $6,200 one-way (air freight + handling). That's higher than lease but faster. If you want mix: 12 loaners + air-bridge 8 = immediate 20 units. Remaining 4 could be backfilled when crossdock clears.

alex: Prefer mix to minimize risk. Approve: reassign 24 from bench, lease 12 loaners for 7 days, air-bridge 8 units. Finance sign-off needed for emergency spend. @tj_ops can you approve budget up to $8k for this?

tj_ops: Approved emergency spend up to $8,000 for lease + crossdock/air, given production impact. Proceed and log expense to infra-runbook. Also open a vendor RMA ticket for PO#8329 — we need traceability.

supply-bot: RMA ticket created: RMA-2026-7745 (linked PO 8329). Status: pending paperwork. Please upload AWB + photos once items ship.

maria: I'll throttle low-priority pipeline jobs and move long-running experiments to cloud to free GPUs. Will monitor queue length and latency.

linh_vendor: Sending draft AWB and proforma invoice now. Note: customs will require HS code re-submission and supporting commercial docs. If you sign updated PO addendum agreeing to split routing, we will absorb 50% of the $680 admin fee.

alex: Fine. Proceed with paperwork. Confirm final spend and lease terms in a moment. Document decisions here so SRE and Finance have a record.

oncall-ops: I added a cluster saturation alert: alert if GPU queue wait > 12 min for > 5m. Will page on escalation.

maria: Once loaners arrive, tag them with temporary prefixes in inventory: TEMP-LN-1..12; track unit serials for swapback and RMA reconciliation.

linh_vendor: Confirmed — loaner serials will be provided in CSV. Crossdock arrival to NL ~48h after you sign docs; customs clearance 24–72h after arrival. Air-bridge ETA 24h from ship.

alex: Summary: reassign 24 bench->prod, lease 12 loaners x7d, air-bridge 8 units, vendor to absorb 50% of customs admin if we accept split routing, RMA-2026-7745 created. Proceed and post AWB when available. :thumbsup:

oncall-ops: Noted. Monitoring in place, will update if any degradation.

linh_vendor: AWB sent to alex@mredwood.com and to supply-bot. Uploads pending.

alex: Thanks — closing this thread; keep updates in the RMA ticket.
